_doc: Versioned record of wallet RPC behaviors SigilKit depends on. The cross-wallet conformance CI asserts these; a mismatch fails the build BEFORE users hit the regression. Add entries per wallet+behavior with the extension/version they were verified on.

behaviors.behavior: MetaMask Agent Wallet restricts agent spending via daily spend limits, allowlisted protocols, and a risk profile; out-of-policy actions require human approval (Guard Mode 2FA, 5-minute auto-decline).
behaviors.sigilkitDependency: Competitive baseline: SigilKit's on-chain grants + fencing must be at least as restrictive; the positioning doc cites this.

behaviors.behavior: Biconomy Smart Sessions expose ERC-7579 policy types: value limits, ERC-20 limits, time bounds, target contract + function selectors, usage count, network restrictions.
behaviors.sigilkitDependency: Direct comparator: SigilKit's grant module must match or exceed these policy dimensions.

behaviors.behavior: User-activated eth_requestAccounts and personal_sign (real button clicks) open the request/approval UI and resolve successfully on 13.x.
behaviors.verifiedOn: extension 13.48.0 (2026-09-22 manual check in Brave against the wallet-e2e dapp fixture; human-driven, not harness-automated)
behaviors.sigilkitDependency: Each harness request must carry real transient activation (fixture button click). Signing/connect flakiness in automation is Playwright context (stale extension tabs, lock state), not wallet refusal of the request.

behaviors.behavior: A raw zero-address EIP-7702 revocation submitted via eth_sendTransaction is REJECTED. In-UI revoke (PR #30969) produces a valid zero-address authorization tuple.
behaviors.verifiedOn: extension 12.5.0 (2026-08 live harness via Playwright + persistent Chromium)
behaviors.sigilkitDependency: SDK must route revocations through in-UI flow for MetaMask users, or use relayer-signed type-4 txs.

behaviors.behavior: eth_sendTransaction accepting an authorizationList field (type-4 relay path) for delegated EOAs.
behaviors.verifiedOn: extension 2025-08 upstream changelog — no live-harness coverage exists for this behavior (only the revoke-rejection canary runs)

behaviors.behavior: Coinbase Smart Wallet implementation address stays 0x000100abaad02f1cfC8Bbe32bD5a564817339E72 behind EIP7702Proxy 0x7702cb554e6bFb442cb743A7dF23154544a7176C.
signAuthorization remains local-account-only (JSON-RPC account signing unsupported pending an ERC).
No EIP-7702 signing support found in Rabby desktop codebase.
